svg.title: macOS · Gallery item view · Masks tab · locked register (＋ Shape and Find disabled) · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Overlay/OverlayMasksPanel.swift (toolbar with shapeToolMenu, deckCard, shapesCard with its findRow, customMasksCard) hosted by App/PhotoViewerView.swift (masksTab, controlRail) inside the Gallery's ITEM VIEW — App/GalleryView.swift (wideLayout, itemHeader), App/GalleryItemView.swift (GalleryFocus, GalleryItemEditor, GalleryFilmstrip), App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift (.inspector) — with the register LOCK of WP0b (2026-09-19, code first by Steven's call): LetsLapseKit/Shapes/ShapeRegisterLock.swift + App/Shapemation/ShapeRegisterLock.swift. Drawn 2026-09-20, mirrored from the Debug build on the wp0b-root scratch library (12 city projects; the register of 'Photo 19. 9. at 20:00' — a 1200×900 JPG of a dark circle and square on grey — is the version-2 fixture wp0b/toonew.json, detectorVersion 4 / version 2, which this build may read but never write) with LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid>:masks, the window set by AX to 1000×700; captures photo-viewer.masks.locked.png and photo-viewer.masks.locked.scrolled.png (the rail scrolled 211.5 pt) + AX dumps. The capture's window was not key — drawn here in the key look (accent lights and buttons). STATE: the Masks tab on a project whose shapes.json is LOCKED. ＋ SHAPE is DISABLED (AXMenuButton '＋ Shape', enabled=0, help 'Shapes written by a newer LetsLapse'; the unreadable case reads 'Shapes couldn't be read') — the bare accent label at 40 % in its seat; the Shapes card's FIND button is DISABLED with the same help text (AXButton 'Find', enabled=0), a #F5F5F5 seat with a #B6B6B6 label; the Use all menu stays enabled. The card counts '0 shapes' and shows the empty-register copy: the locked file's shapes are NOT listed — a register this build cannot write is not read into the tiles either (console: 'shapes: Photo 19. 9. at 20:00 written by a newer LetsLapse (version 2) — left as it is'). THE CHIP SLOT (desc only): the explanatory chip that says WHY the two doors are shut belongs ABOVE THE FIND ROW, between the card header (y 416.5) and the Use all · Find row (y 429) — a later design-first pass, to be drawn as its own variant file (photo-viewer.masks.locked.chip.svg) when it lands; this mirror draws only what the app shows, and until then the only explanation is the help text (a tooltip on hover). COMPONENTS: TAGS and the metadata fields are the shared components; the INFO block and the filmstrip are drawn inline on purpose — components/metadata-info.photo.narrow.svg is the ARW's full camera record (302×221) where this bare JPG yields one row, and components/gallery-filmstrip.photo.svg is the 1310-pt strip of gallery.item.svg's 1350-wide canvas, where this 1000-pt window on a one-project root shows a single 80×60 tile. ITEM VIEW GEOMETRY at 1000×700 (1 unit = 1 pt; window at 20,20): title bar 32 pt with the project's name as the window title; INSPECTOR x 20–350 (GalleryPreviewPanel .inspector, white, its own ScrollView, thumb drawn): the name 16/700, '19. 9. 2026 · 45 KB' 12 secondary, a full-bleed divider, TAGS 13/600 secondary with components/tag-field.empty.narrow (the dashed + Add tag chip — nothing tagged), INFO with the one row a bare JPG gives ('Size · 1200 × 900 · JPG' — no camera, no lens; the photo component draws the ARW's full record), then components/metadata-fields.empty.narrow (Title · Caption · Creator · Copyright · Rating · … with the placeholders, running under the fold; the scrolled capture shows its Country / Country code foot, the Storage row '45 KB', PICPLACE 'Keep a copy on PicPlace · Sign in', Rename · Finder · Delete… and OUTPUT · Share project — gallery.item.interval.svg draws that foot). EDITOR COLUMN: the 52 pt item header (▤ hides the inspector, ‹ Gallery, the name 16/700 centred, '1 of 1' 12 mono — the lock root's one photo project in the grid's order), the MEDIA pane 338×463.5 black with the 4:3 still fitted to its width (338×253.5 at y 210.5; the circle at (491.75, 337) r 56 #282828, the square 576–660.5 × 252.5–337 #3C3C3C on #C8C8C8 — a flat stand-in for the fixture), ⤢ bottom-trailing; no timeline (a single still). RAIL 330 pt: RailTabBar Editor · Text · Masks (298×36 white capsule, 96 pt seats, Masks accent), then the ScrollView (15 pt scroller gutter, so the content is 280.5 wide at x 706.5; thumb drawn as captured): TOOLBAR (30 pt, four 64.1 pt seats, 8 pt gaps) Linear · Radial (white, radius 9, accent 12.5/600) · ＋ Shape (disabled, see above; as shipped the borderlessButton menu drops its dashed box on macOS) · ＋ Custom… (dashed accent-45 % box on accent-4 %, its label wrapped to two lines as shipped); MASKS deck (llCard radius 12, 167.5 tall): 'Masks' 13/600 secondary · '2 masks' mono, two 78.8×59.1 tiles (radius 6, 8 pt gaps) — Sky with the AUTO chip and the cached analysis (an ink region with a jagged top edge over the lower 34.5 pt: what the segmenter made of the synthetic picture, mirrored as captured), Land all-white with its AUTO chip — captions 11/600, the two-line legend 10.5 secondary; SHAPES card (llCard radius 12, 200.5 tall): 'Shapes' 13/600 secondary · '0 shapes' mono, the FIND ROW — the Use all detector menu (99×23.5, #ECECEC, radius 6: 'Use all' 13/600 + a small chevron.down, a divider, the pop-up chevron; its submenus Detector · Sensitivity · Size over ShapeDetectionMode) and the Find button at the trailing edge (48×23.5) — then the engine's one-line detail 11 secondary wrapping to four lines ('Find shapes in this picture · Every detector in turn; a shape found by more than one is listed once with who found it, and every Add or dismissal scores each detector') and the empty copy 12.5 secondary in four lines ('No shapes yet. Find them in this picture above, run Find shapes from the Create tab, or draw one with ＋ Shape. Shapes are what a Shape-mation holds still.'), its last line cut by the pane's bottom edge at 568.5 in the unscrolled capture; CUSTOM MASKS (llCard radius 12, 162 tall, from y 601.5 — below the fold, measured in the scrolled capture and drawn in full geometry under the clip): 'Custom Masks' · '0 masks', the 57.5 pt '＋ Add Custom Mask' drop target (dashed accent-45 % on accent-4 %, radius 10; 13/600 accent over 'Drop a black & white PNG or JPEG' 10.5 tertiary), the three-line footnote 11.5 secondary 'Masks belong to the project, not the layer — every text layer can pick any of them, and any of them can carry a grade.' FILMSTRIP (GalleryFilmstrip, y 570–720 white under the tab bar's clearance): the grid's one project as an 80×60 tile at (36, 582) with the focused ring; the floating five-tab bar over it, Gallery lit. The unlocked register on the same rail — the five register tiles, ◎/✎ captions, the shape detail card — is photo-viewer.masks.svg / photo-viewer.masks.shape.svg (drawn 2026-09-11 in the editor's former standalone window; the Find row measured here is the same code). Hooks: LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid>:masks on a root whose register is locked; LL_SHAPETOOL is refused on a locked register.
